$comment: Architecture styles offered by `anycrew init` and `/crew-patterns`. Same rows as skills/crew-patterns/references/architecture-styles.md, kept machine-readable so init can seed ADR-001.

modular-monolith.name: Modular monolith with hexagonal modules
modular-monolith.shape: One deployable; strict module boundaries (own tables, public API per module, no cross-module imports); inside each module a pure domain behind ports, adapters for I/O.
modular-monolith.choose_when: A startup or mid-size team wants microservice discipline without the operations cost; integrations should be swappable and testable without infrastructure.
modular-monolith.avoid_when: Modules need independent scaling or release today, or the product is a throwaway prototype with no logic worth protecting.
modular-monolith.watch_for: Shared tables across modules; a 'common' module that becomes everything; adapters leaking SDK types into the domain.

layered.name: Layered (n-tier)
layered.shape: Presentation -> application -> domain -> data, each layer calling only the one below.
layered.choose_when: A small team builds a CRUD-heavy product with few integrations.
layered.avoid_when: Business rules keep leaking into controllers or SQL; several entry points share use cases.
layered.watch_for: Anaemic domain; 'utils' layers; every change touching every layer.

hexagonal.name: Hexagonal (ports and adapters)
hexagonal.shape: A pure domain in the middle; ports define what it needs; adapters implement them for databases, APIs and UIs.
hexagonal.choose_when: Tests must run without infrastructure and providers (model vendors, payments, storage) must be swappable.
hexagonal.avoid_when: Throwaway prototypes with no logic worth protecting.
hexagonal.watch_for: Port explosion; adapters leaking SDK types into the domain.

clean.name: Clean / onion architecture
clean.shape: Hexagonal with explicit rings: entities, use cases, interface adapters, frameworks; dependencies point inward.
clean.choose_when: Several entry points (API, CLI, jobs) share the same use cases.
clean.avoid_when: A single thin API over a database.
clean.watch_for: Ceremony: use-case classes that only forward calls.

microservices.name: Microservices
microservices.shape: Independently deployed services, each owning its data, talking over APIs or events.
microservices.choose_when: Several teams need independent release cadences and parts of the system have proven, different scaling needs.
microservices.avoid_when: Fewer than about three teams, or the domain boundaries are still moving.
microservices.watch_for: A distributed monolith; chatty synchronous calls; no observability.

event-driven.name: Event-driven
event-driven.shape: Producers emit facts; consumers react; a broker or log in between.
event-driven.choose_when: Workflows span steps that may fail independently, need fan-out, audit trails or integrations.
event-driven.watch_for: Invisible coupling through event schemas; missing idempotency; no replay story.

cqrs.name: CQRS (optionally with event sourcing)
cqrs.shape: Separate write model (commands) and read models (queries); optionally events as the source of truth with projected read models.
cqrs.choose_when: Complex write rules with many read shapes, audit requirements or temporal queries.
cqrs.avoid_when: Simple CRUD, or a team unfamiliar with projections.
cqrs.watch_for: Eventual-consistency surprises in the UI; projection rebuild cost.

pipeline.name: Pipeline / workflow
pipeline.shape: Ordered stages with explicit state, idempotency keys and retries; the shape of document processing and agent systems.
pipeline.choose_when: Long-running, multi-step jobs: LLM pipelines, document processing, ETL.
pipeline.watch_for: Stages mutating shared state; non-idempotent retries; large payloads in state.

serverless.name: Serverless / functions
serverless.shape: Functions triggered by HTTP or events, with managed scaling.
serverless.choose_when: Spiky load, glue between managed services, little operations capacity.
serverless.avoid_when: Long-running processes, heavy local state, latency-sensitive paths.
serverless.watch_for: Cold starts; vendor lock-in; sprawl without a map.

undecided.name: Undecided
undecided.shape: To be chosen with /crew-patterns once the PRD exists.
undecided.choose_when: The forces (team, change rate, integrations, consistency, scale) are not known yet.
undecided.avoid_when: Code is about to be written: decide first.
undecided.watch_for: Starting specs before the shape is chosen.
